tagline: One sentence, one voice, one audio file.
new_phrases_hint:
Again!
It's my turn.
Leave me alone.
voice_title: What new recordings are made with
empty_start: Nothing here yet. Several lines at once work too — each line becomes its own sentence.
ask_switch_one:
Switch 1 sentence to {voice}?

The existing recording will be replaced.
ask_switch_other:
Switch {n} sentences to {voice}?

The existing recordings will be replaced.
ask_collections_add:
Which collections should these {n} sentences join?

Comma separated. Existing collections stay.
ask_collections_remove:
Which collections should these {n} sentences leave?

Comma separated. Other collections stay.
ask_delete_other:
Delete {n} sentences?

The sentences and their audio files will be removed. This cannot be undone.
ask_edit_text:
Text for {text}

The sentence is recorded again right away. The file name stays {id}.
ask_collections_one:
Collections for {text}

Comma separated. Empty takes the sentence out of all of them.
ask_delete_this:
Really delete {text}?

The sentence and its audio files will be removed. This cannot be undone.
ask_delete_one:
Delete 1 sentence?

The sentence and its audio files will be removed. This cannot be undone.
settings_intro: A key adds the voices of a service. Without one the bundled voices remain — they are enough to start with.
settings_warning: Careful: this interface has no login. Whoever reaches it can set a key here and generate voices on your account. Use it on your own network only.
key_hint: Written to the .env next to your sentences and never shown again.
key_saved: {label} unlocked — {n} voices to choose from now.
backup_intro: The sentences live in this browser. Clearing its data takes them with it, so keep a copy — it is the only thing here that cannot be made again. The audio files can, at any time.
backup_hint: The same phrases.json the container uses, so the two can trade.
done_import_revoiced: {n} of them had a voice this page does not have; they will be recorded in the one selected above.
import_failed: That file could not be read: {error}
footer_local: Everything happens in this browser. Nothing you type is sent anywhere.
ask_collection_delete:
Delete "{name}"?

The collection goes, the {n} sentences in it stay.
voices_local_body: Four piper voices, CC0 or public domain. Downloaded once and then kept on your machine. No account, no key, offline.
azure_body: Azure is a paid service and needs an account. Your key stays in this browser; the request goes from here straight to Microsoft, never through a server of ours.
azure_warn: Recordings made with a cloud voice cannot be made again if the account goes away. The bundled voices stay.
danger_body: Resets mitreden completely: every collection, every sentence and every recording. This cannot be undone.
danger_ask: Really delete everything? {n} sentences and all collections will be gone.
compose_hint: Enter records · Shift + Enter new line
